answer: Make every answer start as a glacier-slow commitment: each identity posts a hash of its draft to the forum early in the epoch, the text frozen behind it. At reveal the answer must match the hash exactly — a bridge anyone can walk across to verify it, no trust required. A sybil fleet can no longer wait, read the passing answers, then clone them across fifty identities, because every text was fixed before any peer answer existed. The only way to run fifty identities is to write fifty distinct passing answers, each one a sonnet of its own, and the cost of that grows with each mouth you feed.
